method: 250 current recipes, seven real locally generated variants each; serialize complete bilingual response fields and final texts, labels trimmed to 40 characters; count with official OpenAI vocabulary files using existing system tiktoken
limitations: Local synthetic response measurement, not a real model output; these are two reference tokenizers, not exact tokenizers for all supported providers. Arbitrary longer user values or actual AI output can still exceed the cap; truncated responses remain rejected without automatic retries.
